# Zynvox

> Zynvox is an AI receptionist and missed-call text-back platform built for US home service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing) and any business that runs on inbound calls. When a call is missed it replies in seconds by text or answers by AI voice, qualifies the customer, books the appointment, updates the CRM, notifies the team and sends reminders and follow-ups — 24/7.

Key facts:
- Workflow: missed call → instant text-back or AI voice answer → AI qualification → booking on the real calendar → CRM update → team and owner notified → reminders, follow-ups and review requests.
- Ten modules: AI Dispatcher, AI Receptionist, Lead Qualification, Appointment Booking, Owner Dashboard, Technician Dispatch, Review Automation, Maintenance Reminders, Knowledge Graph & Business Memory, Operational Intelligence Engine.
- Industries: home services (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, moving), law firms, dental and medical clinics, real estate, auto repair, property management, insurance agencies, salons and med spas, B2B sales teams, and any other business customers call.
- Missed-call revenue leakage = missed calls per month × share that would have booked × share who go to a competitor × average job value × 12.
- Pricing: Starter $197 setup + $79/month; Pro $497 setup + $197/month (founding-partner prices). 14-day free trial, no contract. Details: https://zynvox.tech/pricing/
- Emergencies are escalated to an on-call person, never booked into a later slot; callers are told they are talking to an automated assistant.
- 82% of consumers say they will call a competitor if a business doesn’t answer (CallRail consumer survey, 2025: https://www.callrail.com/blog/missed-calls-cost-businesses-more-than-ever).
- Serves businesses across the United States.
- Contact: taha@zynvox.tech · Book an analysis call: https://cal.com/zynvox/zynvox-consultation
